Alpha challenge: trust verification

Alpha seeks provenance and lineage tooling for verification of autonomous sensor feeds, with full audit trails for operators.

Inner boilerplate: room bookings, schedules, and catering notes for the demonstration day in the main hall.

Every submission must include attestation evidence and explainable outputs that an operator can inspect before acting.

Beta challenge: sensor assurance

Beta funds assurance cases for sensor fusion in command and control posts, with certification evidence reviewed by independent assessors.

Gamma challenge: audit lineage

Gamma funds audit and lineage tooling so every model update carries provenance that a reviewer can replay end to end.

Delta challenge: fail-closed control

Delta funds fail-closed control design with human-autonomy teaming trials and accountability records for each decision.
